Affiliation/createNewAffiliationFormConf:
Tests the Organization Affiliations flow: verifies the "Create New Affiliation" button and form load (header text).  
Creates a new affiliation using a generated child org, selects a single role (FRONTDESK), and confirms the affiliation count increments.
Affiliation/organizationAffiliationAcces: Creates child organizations and a study, then tests adding an affiliation (ADMINISTRATOR role) from a child org to a managing org and verifies affiliated users can see studies across the organizations.
Blume/blumeInvitation.spec.js: Validates the Blume invitation flow: uses the patient page "Resend Invite" to retrieve/send the invite, then completes Blume sign-up (password/PIN variants) and verifies the account status becomes ACTIVE.
Blume/sendToBlumeV2.spec.js: Posts a study and sends an amended final report to Blume V2, signs up a Blume user via the invitation link, and verifies the shared study opens correctly in the Blume viewer with expected toolbar options.
BlumeDemography/blumeDemographicSync.spe:
E2E test for Blume demographic sync: creates a Breeze study/patient, signs up a Blume account, and sends a report to Blume.  
Edits personal information in the Blume profile (gender, marital status, mother’s family name/address) and verifies the updates sync back to OmegaAI/Breeze.
Renames a PDF in the Blume app: uploads a file to a new profile, searches and edits the document name, verifies the rename, then deletes the file.
BlumeDocuments/documentUpload.spec.js: Uploads a PDF (and includes a skipped DICOM test) to a profile across Desktop/Tablet/Mobile viewports, verifies the file via search/thumbnail, selects and deletes it while waiting for the corresponding API calls.
BlumeDocuments/downloadDocument.spec.js: Uploads a PDF to a new Blume profile, searches for and downloads the file, then deletes the document while verifying the related Document API calls.
BlumeDownload/view-study-iv.spec.js: Verifies Blume's "View Study" image viewer is read-only across desktop and mobile viewports, checking toolbar options (Pop Out/Fullscreen disabled; Burn/Toggles/Link/Download/Settings present) and that the image displays.
BlumeDownload/zip-btd-study.spec.js: E2E test for Blume's Completed Appointments covering downloading a study as a ZIP ("Download Results") and triggering "Burn to disc" for a study. It sets up a patient/study via API and DICOM import, then validates the download completion and disc image response headers/body.
Tests the Completed Appointments flow: it creates a study/appointment, then in Blume's Completed Appointments tab opens a patient’s appointment, accesses and submits the Patient Registration and Clinical forms.
Creates study/forms and schedules an appointment for a generated patient, patching patient contact and preparing tokens.  
Logs into Blume, opens the appointment to submit the patient registration and clinical forms and (optionally) verify appointment status transitions.
BlumeHome/appointmentFilter.spec.js: Verifies the Completed Appointments patient filter: creates/patches a study patient via API, opens the Completed Appointments filter, selects the target patient, and asserts the patient appears under the managing organization.
BlumeHome/blumeGlobalSearch.spec.js:
Verifies the Blume global study search across Desktop/Tablet/Mobile viewports.  
Creates a study/patient via API, logs in, searches by studyId and asserts "MY STUDIES" and the expected study entry (description - ID) appear.
BlumeHome/blumeHelpCenter.spec.js:
Checks that clicking the Blume Help navigation opens the Blume Help Center in a new page with URL containing "blumehelp.omegaai.com" after login.  
Performs the check both via the Blume POM method and via POManager access.
BlumeHome/blumeLeftPanelVisual.spec.js: Visual regression test for the Blume home left panel: ensures the left drawer is visible (expanding if needed), screenshots it, and compares with a baseline image expecting no differences.
BlumeHome/blumeUserProfile.spec.js: Validates Blume user profile BMI calculation and category display from metric inputs and checks metric-to-imperial conversions (kg→lb, cm→feet) across Desktop/Tablet/Mobile viewports.
Checks the global search flow by searching "STUDY" and verifying tabs (All/Studies/Help Center) and the "MY STUDIES" result.  
Also verifies the Home link redirects to the welcome page at /home.
BlumePDFForms/submitPDFFormCompletedAppt:
Sets up Blume PDF Registration and Clinical forms, creates a patient appointment and marks the study completed.  
Logs into Blume, opens Completed Appointments, accesses the patient’s forms and submits the Registration and Clinical PDF forms while verifying the PUT API calls.
BlumePDFForms/submitPDFFormScheduledAppt: Confirms a scheduled appointment and submits Registration and Clinical PDF Blume forms for a created patient/appointment, including setup of forms, patient, appointment and Breeze account.
BlumePS/blumeApptSyncToPS.spec.js: Verifies that patient sign-up, uploaded patient documents, and study signing in Blume sync to PS by asserting DB records and HL7 update fields. Also covers (partly skipped) appointment creation flow syncing from Blume to PS.
BlumeWFA/BlumeWorkflowTemplate.spec.js: Creates a Blume WFA send-email workflow (enabling the feature flag, adding a Send Email action to patient) and (skipped) verifies via FHIR API that email task resources are generated for the patient.
DicomIngestion/checkModalityList.spec.js: Imports CT/MG/SC DICOM series into studies and verifies the Image Viewer’s left-panel modality list shows exactly the unique modalities (SC, MG, CT).
DocumentViewer2/dvUpload.spec.js: Verifies uploading a Final Report in the Document Viewer, checks PDF content rendering, then amends the report and confirms amended content/icon and deletion.
DocumentViewer2/reportImportinDV.spec.js:
Creates a study and imports a DICOM, then opens the Document Viewer to verify the imported Final Report PDF contains expected findings. 
Checks the Final report card displays the "FINAL" title.
DocumentViewer2/SpyOnUnexpectedReportUpd:
Ensures adding a preliminary report in the Document Viewer and navigating away does not trigger an unexpected PUT /save auto-save request.  
Uses Playwright route interception to log DiagnosticReport POST payloads and fail the test if a /save PUT is detected.
DocumentViewer2/table.spec.js: Tests creating and persisting a table in the Document Viewer: adds a diagnostic report, inserts/modifies a table, reopens to verify saved ReportContent, then deletes the preliminary report.
DVPerformance/DVReportLoadPerformance.sp:
Exercises the Document Viewer flow: loads a preliminary report into the editor and verifies its text.  
Uploads/renames final and study documents in the study list, verifies PDF content, and cleans up by deleting them.
DVRename/DVRename.spec.js: Tests Document Viewer rename flows — renaming a Preliminary diagnostic report, renaming Study Documents (SD), and uploading/renaming templates (final report rename is present but skipped).
DVRename/DVToolbar.spec.js: Checks the Document Viewer font toolbar by applying various text styles (heading, font family, size, bold/italic/underline/strikethrough, color, alignment) to a report and verifies the styles in-editor and after saving/reopening.
DVRename/FinalReport.spec.js: Validates the Final Report PDF viewer and AI summary flow—uploads/opens a final report, checks title/content, thumbnail toggle, download/print, zoom and open-in-new-window behavior, then triggers and verifies the AI summary panel.
DVReportAccessIndicator/ReportAccessIndi: Validates multi-user DV locking and takeover: ensures when User1 is editing User2 sees locked indicators, and after User1 clicks back User2 gets a Read-Only "Takeover Editing" option and can assume editing.
DVToolbar/DVImageViewercheck.spec.js: Verifies opening/toggling the Document Viewer image viewer (cornerstone viewport) for a DICOM study. Adds a preliminary diagnostic report, downloads it, then deletes it using multi-delete.
DVToolbar/DVReportToolbar.spec.js:
Validates report toolbar states and critical findings flow — create/edit/preview/sign/delete reports and verify PDF content and critical-finding icon behavior.  
Also tests report comparison via drag-and-drop, multi-report download and multi-delete in the Document Viewer.
DVToolbar/NextStudySingleMonitor.spec.js:
Validates navigating to the next study, adding/signing diagnostic reports and uploading documents across two studies in the Document Viewer.  
Verifies prior-study cards and PDF/document content and checks Current/Prior/All study filter behavior.
DVToolbar/PublicURL.spec.js:
Validates PublicLink/QR code generation in the Document Viewer by creating a report/template and checking the public URL is inserted into the tiptap editor.  
Signs and moves to the next study to ensure a new PublicLink is created and the URL is again embedded.
EmbeddedDV/embeddedDV.spec.js: Covers Embedded Diagnostic Viewer flows: create/edit (auto-save) and sign a preliminary DiagnosticReport in the image viewer split view and verify the final report appears; upload a final report PDF and validate its display/content.
EmergencyAccess/emergencyAccessSearch.sp: Tests the Emergency Access search flow (ensuring the privilege is enabled), opening the Emergency Access dialog and verifying patient lookup by full name + email or full name + phone navigates to the patient/profile/study results.
FaxLog/FaxLog.spec.js: Sends a diagnostic report via fax: generates a study, adds and signs a report in the document viewer, sends a fax to a number, then filters and verifies the fax log entry for the patient.
Forms/orderForm.spec.js: Covers creating and publishing an Organizational Order Form (via UI or PDF upload), creating an order using the form/order set, filling and submitting the form, and verifying it appears in Study History.
Forms/TechnologistForm.spec.js: Uploads/creates and publishes a Technologist Form (including dragging bookmark fields and setting metadata), then verifies it appears, binds accession data, and is editable in the image viewer/split view.
GlobalSearch/globalStudySearch.spec.js: Covers Global Study Search: verifies searching a posted study returns the expected result and navigates to the image viewer. Also validates Recently Viewed and Recently Searched behaviors (autosuggest selection, recent items content and eviction when new searches are added).
ImageViewer/Bookmark.spec.js: Verifies ImageViewer bookmark persistence: toggles "Save Bookmarks", imports studies, sets a 3x3 layout and opens panels/DV split, then checks that layout and panel states are saved and restored after reload.
ImageViewer/imageViewer.spec.js: Verifies the ImageViewer flow: imports a DICOM study, opens the viewer and checks patient banner, patient card, and study explorer/series thumbnails. Confirms topbar controls like layout change and share/send drawer.
ImageViewer/ImageViewerViewport.spec.js: Verifies that rotation and zoom adjustments made in a multi-view ImageViewer persist when double-clicking to switch to the highlighted view and back. Simulates selecting rotate/zoom tools and mouse drags, then asserts the viewport's rotation and zoom are preserved.
ImageViewer/initiateLoadingImage.spec.js: Imports a DICOM study, opens the Image Viewer, and verifies the image auto-populates into the viewport with the SaveBookmarks localStorage toggle both ON and OFF.
ImageViewer/minimumAccessIV.spec.js: Verifies that users can access the 3D Image Viewer using minimal URL parameters (StudyInstanceUIDs or AccessionNumber+PatientID with internalManagingOrganizationID) after importing a DICOM study, and checks that images render correctly in the viewport.
ImageViewer/overlayDataImages.spec.js:
Covers applying overlay data to a DICOM image in the Image Viewer by toggling overlay annotations and changing the layout.  
Asserts correct overlay rendering by comparing the viewport screenshot to a baseline image using a mocked AI image comparator.
ImageViewer/shareStudyMode.spec.js:
Creates a public study link by sending a study to an external user, opens the link to verify the access/verification flow, report viewing, and image viewer layout.  
Verifies default Hanging Protocols are available in Share Study mode.
ImageViewerAdjustmentTools/imageControlW:
Verifies Image Viewer control wheel customization (division 8/6/4) and that the correct adjustment tools are enabled and present in the wheel popup. 
Checks markup tool enable/disable states and exercises selecting markup tools (Angle, Annotate, Cardiothoracic) from the control wheel.
ImageViewerAdjustmentTools/orgLevelWLPre:
Creates an organization-level Window/Level preset in the Image Viewer for a study.  
Verifies the preset is visible to a different user, applies it, and checks the image display and WL overlay values.
ImageViewerAdjustmentTools/windowLevelOn: Verifies Window Level (WW/WL) behavior on 2D and multi-frame 3D mammography images by switching to multi-view, opening MG studies, and checking expected WL/WW values per viewport. Also scrolls through 3D frames to ensure WL is applied across all frames.
ImageViewerAdjustmentTools/windowLevelPr: Validates Image Viewer Window/Level preset CRUD: add, verify, apply, modify, delete, and ensure presets (including default WL) apply correctly across layout and scrolling changes.
ImageViewerAdjustmentTools/windowLevelTo: Validates the Image Viewer Window/Level tool by importing a study, selecting the WL control, then simulating horizontal drags to change Window Width and vertical drags to change Window Center, asserting WW and WC update as expected.
ImageViewerHangingProtocol/defaultHangin: Verifies the Default Hanging Protocols list and that a default protocol (MR Brain) is read-only/un-deletable, then duplicates it to create and edit a new hanging protocol (rename, set organization/modality).
ImageViewerHangingProtocol/hangingProtoc: Creates, verifies, modifies, and deletes ImageViewer Hanging Protocols: imports CT/PET studies, creates an HP with CT layout and window presets, updates it to PET with a new name, then removes it and verifies deletion.

Creates, saves, applies and then deletes a Hanging Protocol with a "prior" setup, verifying layout/series mapping and that the prior study's acquisition date is highlighted while the current study's isn't.
Imports a 4-file DICOM study, opens the Image Viewer and applies an MR Brain hanging protocol to verify only two viewports show images while two remain empty; then switches to a manual 2x2 layout to confirm all four viewports display images and overlays.
ImageViewerHangingProtocol/tomoHangingPr: Verifies the TOMO hanging protocol in the Image Viewer by importing TOMO DICOMs, opening the study, and checking multi-viewport layouts and step navigation (RMLO/LMLO/RCC/LCC and subsequent steps).
ImageViewerImport/imageViewerDICOMandPDF:
Uploads PDF and DICOM files into the ImageViewer via the explorer, opening a posted study and importing documents.  
Verifies series appears with expected name/frames count and that the viewport renders the imported images.
ImageViewerMarkupTools/imageWheelToolUSM: Validates that importing a US DICOM and using the Image Viewer length tool shows correct units (px in one region, "cm US Region" in another) and that the probe tool reports time in seconds.
ImageViewerMarkupTools/LengthMeasurement:
Verifies the Image Viewer Length measurement tool for US modality by importing a US DICOM, opening the viewer and selecting the Length markup.  
Draws a measurement and asserts the displayed numeric value and 'cm' unit are shown (and not 'px').
ImageViewerMarkupTools/measurementsPanel: Tests the Measurements Panel flow: assigns/validates Spine Labeling hotkey, creates Spine Labeling, Length, Arrow Annotation (and Rectangle ROI) measurements, verifies their display/values in the panel, and deletes them.
ImageViewerMarkupTools/MeasurementUnitOn: Verifies that the Length markup tool on CR X‑ray images displays measurements in mm (and not px) across both image viewer windows in a multi‑monitor (1x1) setup.
Checks that in single-monitor (1x1) Image Viewer, using the Length markup on an imported CR/X‑ray draws a measurement that displays in "mm" and not "px".
ImageViewerMarkupTools/PtSuvMeasurements:
Covers the PT SUV measurement flow in the Image Viewer: draws a Rectangle ROI, verifies the SUV menu and default Area/Perimeter metrics.  
Switches SUV units (SUVbw, SUVbsa, SUVlbm) to verify Max/Mean values and that the last unit selection is cached so the menu doesn't reappear.
ImageViewerMarkupTools/spineLabelingOnAx: Ensures the 'N' hotkey is set for Spine Labeling, uses the tool to place labels on the axial series, then switches to a 1x2 layout and scrolls frames to verify labels (C2, C1-C2, C1) appear on the corresponding views.
ImageViewerMoreOptions/customizeOverlays:
Adds a custom overlay using a DICOM tag (Station Name), verifies it appears in Detailed tier (1x1 layout), then deletes and confirms removal.  
Repeats the same flow for Minimal tier (3x2 layout) to ensure overlays show and can be removed.
ImageViewerMoreOptions/imagesScroll.spec: Verifies Image Viewer scrollbar behavior: imports DICOM files, opens a study, clicks through image items and checks the scrollbar position updates to match the selected image.
ImageViewerMoreOptions/moreOptionsImageV:
Tests the Image Viewer "More Options" menu flow after importing a study and opening the viewer.
Verifies the menu item list and each submenu/option (Toggles, Link Series, Download, Settings, Popout in Window, Fullscreen Mode).
ImageViewerMoreOptions/scrollBetweenSeri: Verifies scrolling between series in the Image Viewer using a hanging protocol with scroll enabled—imports two DICOMs, applies the PTHP layout, maximizes a viewport, and checks mouse-wheel scroll navigates between series (S#:1 ↔ S#:3).
ImageViewerQCModule/checkCineThumbnail.s: Imports a cine DICOM into a generated study, opens the image viewer, and verifies the cine series thumbnail is visible in the Study Explorer left pane.
ImageViewerQCModule/deleteFrames.spec.js:
Covers the Delete Frames flow in the Image Viewer for multi-image and single-image series.  
Verifies the delete dialog options (Cancel, Delete Current Frame, Delete Frame Set), thumbnail frame counts, and UI updates after deletions.
ImageViewerQCModule/dragSereiesToMaxLayo: Switches to a 1x2 layout, maximizes the second viewport, then drags a series from the Study Explorer into the maximized viewport and verifies images display.
ImageViewerQCModule/mergeStudy.spec.js:
Tests merging and unmerging studies in the Image Viewer: reparenting a series via drag-and-drop, deleting a series, performing merge/unmerge actions and validating series counts and API calls.  
Sets up by posting/importing multiple DICOM studies and opening the image viewer.
ImageViewerQCModule/QCModel.spec.js: Covers Image Viewer QC flows: imports DICOMs then tests renaming a series, deleting a series, and deleting a study via the left-side explorer.
ImageViewerQCModule/QCModelReparent.spec: Verifies the "reparent series" flow in the ImageViewer: imports test DICOMs, opens the viewer, then drags a series between studies and asserts the POST /reparent/ API call.
ImageViewerQCModule/studyExplorerSelecti: Verifies Study Explorer frameset selection in the Image Viewer: sets 1x1 layout, selects the first frameset checkbox and asserts its check icon is visible while the second frameset remains unselected.
ImageViewerQCModule/sutydMergeUnmenrge.s: Verifies the Image Viewer study merge/unmerge flow: merges two studies (checks combined series and hidden accordion), then unmerges via UI/API and confirms series counts and that the study explorer shows two separate studies.
ImageViewerSpecificModality/doseReport.s: Verifies Dose Report rendering in the Image Viewer: imports a DICOM study, opens the viewer, adjusts layout and overlays, captures the viewport and compares the screenshot to a baseline doseReport image expecting an exact match.
ImageViewerSpecificModality/MGImages.spe:
Validates MG (mammography) image viewer in 1x2 layout, checking LCC/RCC overlay positions and CSS classes.  
Toggles CAD on/off and asserts CAD annotations and summary appear and disappear.
ImageViewerSpecificModality/MLOProjectio: Imports mammography DICOMs, opens the study in the image viewer, and verifies all four MLO projection viewports (LCC, RCC, LMLO, RMLO) are displayed.
ImageViewerSpecificModality/videoImage.s: Verifies a DICOM video opens in the image viewer, asserts the video element is rendered and sized, then plays to confirm currentTime advances and pauses to confirm playback stops.
ImageViewerToolbar/ClampedWindowLevel.sp: Verifies the Clamped Window Level tool selection (toolbar or Customize Toolbar) in the image viewer and uses horizontal/vertical/diagonal mouse drags to assert the VOI is clamped at lower=0 while the upper value changes as expected.
ImageViewerToolbar/clickDoneWithoutDV.sp: Creates a study and sets the user to Performing Technologist, opens the image viewer, clicks the Done/Sign button (without DV) and verifies the study status becomes VERIFIED.
ImageViewerToolbar/customizeToolbar.spec:
Customize Toolbar in Image Viewer: resets toolbar to default, toggles additional and markup tools (enable/disable) and saves changes.
Verifies toolbar reflects changes by applying a length measurement (checks right-panel entry) and confirms reset-all clears all toolbar buttons.
ImageViewerToolbar/customizeToolbarAI.sp: Validates the Image Viewer "Customize Toolbar" flow (via AI commands): opens Settings from More menu, adds/removes Additional/Markup/Adjustment tools, saves/resets/undoes changes, and verifies toolbar state with image comparisons.
ImageViewerToolbar/FusionMPRMode.spec.js: Imports CT/PET series, opens the Image Viewer, switches to MPR and Fusion modes, and verifies viewport counts and that MPR/fusion viewports preserve/synchronize window/level (VOI) with the original CT/PET viewports.
ImageViewerToolbar/imageViewerOnMobileDe: Checks DICOM import and that the ImageViewer opens and displays a study (viewport ready) on mobile/tablet devices (iPad Pro 11" and Galaxy Tab S9 Ultra) after login.
Tests Image Viewer toolbar navigation: verifies "Go Back", "Done", and "Done & Open Next" behaviors—navigating between studies and returning to the worklist while checking patient/accession info.
ImageViewerToolbar/notes.spec.js: Covers Image Viewer notes workflow: opening the viewer, adding a text note, discarding an unsaved note, and deleting saved notes from the notes list.
Tests the Image Viewer toolbar's Reset All and Undo: Reset All should restore the original window/level and zoom, while Undo reverts only the last change (e.g., zoom after WL).
ImportStudy/avoidDuplicateStudies.spec.j: Imports three DICOM files with the same study UID but different accession numbers via API, then verifies in the UI (filtered by managing organization and patient) that only one study is created and duplicates are suppressed.
ImportStudy/blobTokenUnique.spec.js: Reparents a series via drag-and-drop between studies in the image viewer, then re-imports the same DICOM and verifies the instance's blob token is unique/has the expected 5-segment path.
ImportStudy/importDeletedStudy.spec.js:
Verifies re-import of a soft-deleted study with updated DICOM metadata.  
Imports a study, soft-deletes it, re-imports an updated file, then checks updated accession number and study ID appear in the worklist.
ImportStudy/importEmptyAccessNumber.spec: Imports a DICOM study with an empty accession number and verifies in the worklist (filtered by managing org and patient) that the study appears and its accession number cell is blank.
ImportStudy/importMergedPatient.spec.js: Imports two patients via DICOM, merges them, imports an additional study for the merged patient, and verifies all three studies appear in the worklist filtered by managing organization and patient name.
ImportStudy/importMigrationStudy.spec.js: Imports a migration DICOM study into the managing org, opens the image viewer for a patient, verifies a 1x1 image is displayed and checks the study info (S#: 601) is visible.
ImportStudy/importSamePIDDifferentPatien:
Imports two studies with the same PID but different patient names into the managing organization.  
Verifies one study is marked PID_DUPLICATED and the other receives a regenerated non-empty PID (not 'PID_ABC').
ImportStudy/importToDuplicatedOrgName.sp: Verifies importing a DICOM study when two child organizations have the same name results in a single ImagingStudy tied to the correct managing organization, and deleting it does not create/affect the duplicate-named org.
Licensing/AugnitoLicensing.spec.js: Verifies Augnito voice-dictation licensing in the document viewer: creates or detects an OrganizationLicense via API to ensure the "Voice Dictation - Powered by Augnito" button appears, then deletes the license and confirms it reverts to the plain "Voice Dictation" button.
LogView/logView.spec.js:
Validates Audit Logs, Activity History, and DICOM Log pages by opening each view for a created/imported ImagingStudy.  
Applies and verifies multiple filter types (suggest, text, dropdown, date presets, multi-select) and asserts results in the first row.
MemoryLeakTests/DVMemoryleak.spec.js: Checks Document Viewer (DV) for memory leaks by opening the viewer, creating preliminary and diagnostic reports across multiple studies while capturing heap snapshots, then asserts memory growth stays within the configured limit.
MemoryLeakTests/IVMemoryLeak.spec.js:
Verifies the Image Viewer "Done & Open Next" navigation across multiple imported studies while capturing heap snapshots to detect memory leaks.  
Asserts memory growth stays within configured IV limits and generates a memory report.
MirthOutboundAndReportDateTime/mirthOutb: Checks that signing off a DiagnosticReport triggers creation of a Mirth outbound Task for that report. Also verifies the ImagingStudyWorklist entry for the study contains a non-empty dateTimeRead after sign-off.
MultiMonitor/applyHPOnMM.spec.js: Creates a hanging protocol via API, imports multiple DICOMs, opens multi-monitor image viewer popups and verifies the image viewer pages load and the hanging protocol is applied in MM mode.
MultiMonitor/multiMonitorDoneButton.spec: Verifies multi-monitor Image Viewer flow where opening a study spawns Document Viewer + second IV popups; it imports DICOMs, adds a diagnostic report, drags a bookmark into the editor and performs sign-off from the Document Viewer while asserting patient/study details across windows.
MultiMonitorNextStudy/multiMonitorDoneNN: Tests signing and completing a diagnostic report across multi-monitor popups: opens image/document viewers, adds/saves a report in the Document Viewer, then uses Done/Next study navigation to verify correct behavior and popup handling.
OrderDrawer/addNewOrder.spec.js:
Creates a new order from the worklist using the Add Order drawer for an existing patient with multiple consulting physicians, then verifies order and study details on the order page.  
BeforeAll provisions managing/imaging organizations, patient, procedure codes, multiple order sets, and various physicians for the test.
organization/financialType.spec.js: Tests Organization Financial Type management: create (with filtering/search), update, duplicate/required-field validation errors, and delete flows.
organization/orderSet.spec.js: End-to-end tests for Organization RIS Order Set CRUD: create (with duplicate prevention), update (verifies multi-select fields and persisted form values), and delete an order set.
organization/orderSetInheritance.spec.js: Verifies Order Set inheritance between master and child organizations — creating an order set in one org and ensuring view/update/delete functionality from the other org.
organization/payer.spec.js: Tests Organization Payer CRUD and validations: creates a payer (verifies column filters and form values), updates it, checks duplicate/mandatory field errors, and deletes the payer.
organization/payerInheritance.spec.js: Verifies payer inheritance between master and child organizations. Ensures a user can create a payer in one org (master or child) and view, update, and delete it from the other org.
organization/procedureCode.spec.js: Validates Organization Procedure Code CRUD and filtering flows — create (with form validation and duplicate error), update, delete, and filter by columns including Order Set linkage.
organization/procedureCodeInheritance.sp: Verifies procedure code inheritance and CRUD across master and child organizations: a master-org user can create a procedure code in the master and view/update/delete it in a child org, and likewise create in a child and manage it in the master.
organization/selfScheduling.spec.js: Updates Organization Self-Scheduling settings (upload logo, phone, website), saves them, and verifies the updated phone and website appear on the public booking page.
organization/worklistStudyStatusList.spe:
Toggles the Administrator "Override Study Status Transition" privilege and searches a study in the Worklist to open the Study Status menu.  
Verifies which status options are shown/hidden based on the switch and confirms a status update succeeds.
PatientChart/PatientDocuments.spec.js:
Validates the Patient Chart "Patient Documents" card: checks visibility, tab presence, and document counts from DocumentReference/Form APIs. 
Uploads a document, verifies the count and visibility, opens the viewer, drags the uploaded file into the viewport, and checks Registration Form tab behavior.
PatientChart/PatientInfo.spec.js: Checks the Patient Chart "Patient Info" card in the Document Viewer shows correct patient name, formatted birthdate and gender, and validates the card titles/count are displayed and expandable.
PatientInformation/coverageInformation.s: E2E tests for patient Coverage Information covering viewing, adding (with/without creating a new payer), editing and deleting coverages. Also verifies UI behaviors like insurance card handling and field enable/disable states for payer types (including self-pay).
PatientInformation/patientAlert.spec.js:
E2E flow for Patient Alert CRUD on a generated patient.  
Creates, updates, and deletes alerts via the UI, verifying preview, date range and alert card contents while waiting for POST/PUT API calls.
PatientInformation/patientAllergy.spec.j: Tests Patient Allergy CRUD flows: creating, editing, and deleting allergies via the Patient Allergy page using the drawer form, API waits, and card verifications.
PatientInformation/patientInformation.sp: Covers the Patient Information page flows: verifies viewing patient details, updating general patient fields (name/SSN/ID/birthdate) and creating/updating/deleting emergency contacts with API interception/verification.
PatientInformation/patientLinkAndMerge.s: E2E tests for linking, navigating between, unlinking, and merging patients from the Patient Information page, verifying patient cards, form details, toast messages, and correct navigation behavior.
Picklist/PicklistCustomFields.spec.js:
Creates a picklist and custom field in a document template, publishes it, loads the template into a DiagnosticReport and verifies the picklist option appears in the saved report.  
Then updates the picklist options and enters text into the custom field in the report editor to confirm the changes persist after saving.
ReferringPhysicianFlow/newOrderByReferri:
Creates a new imaging order selecting a referring physician and organization, adds a patient and order set, and submits the order.  
Verifies the success message and that the study appears in the referring physician’s worklist with expected click-wheel icon visibility.
ReferringPhysicianFlow/NoStudiesVisibleF: Verifies that a newly created referring physician and organization see zero studies, ensuring studies created for a different referring physician/org are not visible.
ReferringPhysicianFlow/otherReferringPhy: Creates a study as one referring physician, then signs up/logs in as a second referring physician and verifies the unassigned study appears in the second physician's worklist.
Role/affiliationRoleSetting.spec.js: Verifies the "Organization Affiliation" toggle in role settings — visible and ON for ADMINISTRATOR, visible and OFF for TECHNOLOGIST. Creates a custom role, enables the affiliation, saves to confirm it persists, then deletes the role.
study/priorAuthDrawer.spec.js:
Tests editing and saving Prior Authorization details across multiple coverage tabs in the Prior Auth drawer: fills per-coverage fields, submits, and verifies persistence after reopening.  
Sets up a study and multiple coverages via API beforehand and validates authorization numbers and amounts.
study/studyInfo.spec.js: E2E tests for the StudyInfo page: verify study details display and exercise updating General (including Study Type), Clinical, Care Team, and Procedure Code sections, asserting changes persist and related data updates.
study/studyInfoHeaderButtons.spec.js:
Verifies Study Info header buttons: ImageViewer and DocumentViewer open correct viewer pages; Prior Authorization opens the form (Billing skipped).  
Tests Post Charges flow including toggling the role switch and validating success/unsuccessful toast messages.
StudyReactivation/studyDeletion.spec.js: Verifies deletion of a study that has multiple DiagnosticReport documents: creates/imports a study and DICOMs via API, uploads two final reports in the viewer, then deletes the study from the home page and confirms it’s removed.
StudyReactivation/studyReactivation.spec: Tests study reactivation/import and image viewer flow, intercepts the /fhir/DiagnosticReport POST to assert the captured subject.id matches the PatientInfo URL param. Also verifies the correct (or blank) report opens for the expected patient to catch report-patient mismatches.
Imports a DICOM study to the managing org, deletes it via FHIR, then re-imports an updated study. Logs into the UI, opens the image viewer for the patient and verifies the image and study info (S#: 901).
TeachingFolder/teachingFolder.spec.js: E2E tests for Teaching Folder management: create/edit/delete folders and subfolders, add studies from the worklist into a folder, and share the folder with others.
Checks that opening the embedded Image/Document Viewer does not automatically trigger an unexpected DiagnosticReport POST (i.e., auto-save) without user interaction.
templates/HeaderNFooter.spec.js: Creates/updates a Document Viewer template with header/footer and page margins, verifies the rendered CSS paddings/margins in the editor, then removes the header/footer and deletes the template.
templates/template.spec.js: E2E tests for template management: create, search, edit, and publish-as-new templates. Also verifies loading/applying templates in the document and image viewers (including best-match/embedded report flows).
User/createUser.spec.js:
Adds/creates a practitioner user to an organization via the UI, covering DB setup and retry logic.  
Verifies handling of NPI/email conflict by asserting the "User Already Exists" dialog and proceeding to attach the existing user.
User/disableLoginEmail.spec.js: Checks that a practitioner's "Login Email" field is editable only when the PractitionerRole API response lacks an Auth0UserID extension; if Auth0UserID exists the field must be disabled and show the security tooltip.
Visits/order.spec.js: E2E tests for the Order Information page: validate order counts and detailed fields, edit an order via the drawer (accession, dates, priority, referring physician/org), and add a study to an order and confirm it appears on the Worklist.
Visits/visit.spec.js: E2E tests for the Visit Information flow: open visit details, validate header/visit metadata and left-panel visit count, verify expand/collapse of sections, and check/edit visit details including plan-of-care and follow-up instructions.
WFAAppointment/AppointmentStatusSendEmai: Verifies the Workflow Automation that triggers on appointment status "Arrived" and creates send-email actions to specific users/reading physician. Creates an appointment, updates its status to Arrived, and checks FHIR Task resources to confirm emails were sent.
Tests cloning the "Amendment Request" workflow automation: copy, rename, cancel/save flows, verify editor actions/notifications and card step count, then delete the cloned workflow.
WFACloneAndConfig/cloneStudyStatusTransi:
Tests cloning the "OAI Study Status Transitions" workflow: copies the default workflow and verifies UI states, cancel/edit/save flows, and editor contents (trigger, conditions, actions).  
Then verifies the workflow card shows the correct step count and deletes the cloned workflow.
Verifies default Workflow Automations cannot be copied (Copy option hidden) and ensures the 'Done' and 'Amendment Request' actions are not available in the Operation trigger.
Verifies the default "Amendment Request" workflow card is present and read-only, checks its steps/actions in the editor, then creates and signs a DiagnosticReport to trigger an amendment and confirms the study status changes to "TO BE AMENDED".
WFADefault/defaultStudyStatusTransitions: Checks the default "OAI Study Status Transitions" workflow card is present and read-only, and validates its editor steps/conditions/actions. Creates and signs a DiagnosticReport, verifies final report content and that the study status transitions to SIGNED.
WFAOperation/operationCriticalFindingFla: Configures a Workflow Automation operation trigger "Critical Finding Flagged" to send SMS and Email to patients. Then flags a diagnostic report as critical and verifies the critical icon plus corresponding FHIR Task entries for SMS and Email.
WFAOperation/signedReportOperationTrigge: Sets up a "Signed Report" operation workflow (send email to specific user & reading physician, distribute report via email/fax), signs a diagnostic report, and then verifies corresponding email tasks and fax records via FHIR.
WFAStudyPriority/studyPriority.spec.js:
Creates a study via API and logs into the app.  
Adds a Workflow Automation with a Study Priority trigger and configures a Send Email action to a specific user, then cleans up the created patient.
WFAStudyStatusAction/statusStudySendEmai: Sets up a StudyStatus (COMPLETED) trigger with send-email actions, imports a DICOM to trigger the status. Verifies a FHIR task/email is created for the reading physician/specific user after dicomInjection.
WFAStudyStatusAction/studyStatusSendEmai:
Tests that the StudyStatus "VERIFIED" workflow automation sends emails with a Study URL to specific users and patients and verifies those links open correctly in OAI and Blume.  
Sets up a study and workflow actions, advances study status, extracts the Study URL from task logs, and asserts the patient page loads.
WFAStudyStatusAction/studyStatusSendSMSA: Creates a StudyStatus trigger with a Send SMS action, updates a study status to SIGNED, and verifies Workflow Automation generates a Task for the SMS (confirming the SMS send to the configured recipient).
WFAStudyStatusCondition/statusStudyMissM:
Creates a StudyStatus workflow trigger for CONFIRMED with a mismatch condition (missing procedureCode) and an email action to a specific user.  
Updates the ImagingStudy to CONFIRMED and removes procedureCode, then verifies a task/email was generated by the automation.
WorklistAppointment/appointment.spec.js:
Creates an appointment in the scheduler, updates its status/priority, and verifies the changes reflect in the appointment details and worklist grid.  
Also validates backend sync when study/order resources change (e.g., ARRIVED/URGENT) and that a Mirth outbound task is created.
WorklistAppointment/recurringBlockTime.s: Creates a recurring block time in the scheduler for a healthcare service (adds a block with a note) and then updates the block's note, verifying both create and update API calls and UI visibility.
WorklistAppointment/singleBlockTime.spec:
Creates a single-block appointment in the scheduler (adds a note, waits for Appointment POST, and verifies visibility).  
Edits the same block’s note (triggers Appointment PUT) and verifies the updated note is visible.
WorklistBehaviors/worklistBehaviors.spec:
Validates worklist layout persistence — applies filters/grouping, resizes/reorders/sorts columns, navigates away and back to ensure changes are retained and restored after “clear all”.  
Includes a skipped test that creates a user worklist and verifies secondary/tertiary insurance fields and filtering by prior authorization numbers.
WorklistBehaviors/worklistSetDefault.spe:
Tests setting/unsetting a user's default worklist via both the Worklist Settings editor and the Worklist Selector menu.  
Creates a temporary worklist, toggles defaults to verify behavior, then restores the original and deletes the temp.
WorklistCalendar/WorklistCalendar.spec.j:
Creates a user worklist and verifies calendar layout changes (time interval and Day/Week view) can be modified, saved, and persist after reload.  
Also checks calendar behavior when navigating away (to organization) and back, ensuring saved state and UI visibility.
WorklistColor/defaultBackgroundColor.spe: Intercepts StudyStatus API to remove status colors, then verifies worklist color-ball cells show the default black background and rows have no gradient when studyStatusColor is missing.
WorklistColor/worklistColor.spec.js: Verifies that each worklist row's ColorBallCell displays the correct study-status color (fetched from StudyStatus FHIR) across rows. Also checks the color ball appears in the first column with a tooltip on hover and that selecting a row applies a gradient background using the status color.
WorklistDateTimeRangePicker/worklistDate: Validates the Worklist "Study Date/Time" filter shows correct capsule and picker formats for date-only ranges, single whole-day dates, and non-whole-day date-time ranges (including time display).
WorklistDynamicAdvanceFilters/dynamicAdv: Validates dynamic advanced worklist filters: covers string-column operators (Exact/Contains/Not Contains/Starts With/Ends With/Smart Search) for Managing Organization and Patient Name, and array-string filtering for Modality (Contains/Not Contains/Exact Match) after updating studies via API.
Verifies the Old Worklist filtering flow: checks suggestion-based filter for Managing Organization, single-column Patient Name filter, multi-select Modality filter (MR/CT), and clearing filters.
Verifies Worklist filter behaviors: filtering by Study Date/Time (date and minute ranges), filtering by blank Referring Physician, and that applying a Study ID filter narrows the Managing Organization options.
WorklistGrouping/worklistGrouping.spec.j:
Covers worklist grouping by Study Status, # of Images, and Last updated date.  
Includes changing a study's status via the UI to verify group movement/counts and importing DICOM to validate image-count grouping.
WorklistNavigation/worklistNavigation.sp: Verifies that worklist grouping by Patient Name stays expanded after navigating to the Document Viewer and back, and that the grouping collapses when the grouping cache time expires.
WorklistRcmBehaviors/worklistRcmBehavior:
Tests the worklist right-click study-related menu: ensures menu items are visible and navigate to Study, Patient, Order, Document Viewer, Image Viewer, Study History and Send pages.
Verifies the Study Status submenu respects the managing organization's configured statuses and ordering (min/max settings).
Tests the worklist right-click "Download Study" menu validating standard and de-identified downloads produce .zip files and the "Burn Study" option produces a .exe.
WorklistRcmPlayerAssignment/worklistRcmP: Assigns study players (Performing/Reading/Referring Physicians, Technologist, Transcriptionist) via the worklist right‑click menu after creating a study via API and verifies the assignment (checkmark and UNASSIGN option).
WorklistRcmStudyActions/worklistRcmStudy: Verifies Worklist right-click Study Actions: update Order Priority and Study Status, add a study to the Teaching Folder, and delete a study (using an API-created study).
WorklistSelection/worklistSelection.spec: Verifies multi-row selection in the worklist using Ctrl-click and Shift-drag interactions, asserting selected rows have the checked/selected class.
WorklistSelector/roleWorklistSelector.sp: Creates a Role Worklist using the "Try New Worklist" toggle (adds columns and saves), then verifies searching/filtering the worklist selector by worklist name and role; cleans up by deleting created worklists.
WorklistSelector/userWorklistSelector.sp: E2E tests for the User Worklist Selector covering creating a user worklist, switching/selecting/searching it, editing and duplicating the worklist (with API cleanup); also includes a skipped filters/sorting test and creation of multiple worklists.
WorklistSelector/worklistSelector.spec.j:
Worklist Selector: validates opening the selector, create/edit flows and quick-save behavior when filters, sorting or column reorder change, and persistence of the save icon across navigation.  
Also verifies scrollbar/auto-scroll behavior to bring a newly created/current worklist into view and cleans up created worklists.
WorklistSettings/roleWorklistSettings.sp: Creates a new Role Worklist in Role Mode by selecting the managing organization, entering a generated name, adding required columns (Accession #, Managing Organization, Patient Name, Study Status, Priority) and saving to capture the worklist ID.
WorklistSettings/userWorklistSettings.sp: Covers creating user worklists (columns/filters/sorting), switching between multiple user worklists, and verifying the worklist grid updates/filters accordingly.
WorklistSort/worklistCtrlPressedMultiSor: Verifies Ctrl+Click multi-column sorting on the Worklist: adds/removes columns and normal clicks toggle/reset sort directions, asserting the POST sort payloads.
WorklistSort/worklistSort.spec.js: Verifies single-column sorting in the Worklist: clicking column headers toggles Asc/Desc, switching columns clears previous sort, and cycling removes sort — asserted via POST sort payloads.
WorklistSync/worklistSync.spec.js: Verifies worklist sync by checking that backend FHIR updates (patient name, ServiceRequest priority, and ImagingStudy status) are reflected in the UI worklist.
WorklistToggle/worklistToggleOffBehavior: Verifies worklist behavior with the new worklist toggle turned off by opening a study visit from the worklist grid. Also creates a user worklist and assigns Reading, Performing, and Referring Physicians via the worklist UI.
WorklistToolbar/worklistToolbar.spec.js: E2E tests for the Worklist toolbar covering filter overflow into the three‑dots menu, refresh-button cooldown, frozen grouped rows when scrolling, and selected-row count/selection/reset behavior (including grouping and lazy load).
WorklistWheel/clickWheel.spec.js: Verifies the OAI Worklist click-wheel and double-click behaviors: after filtering to a patient, it opens Patient Info, Order, Study from the click-wheel and opens the Image Viewer via double-click.
